purpose: Investigate the longer cache-candidate observation on complete CloudStack using repeated counterbalanced release runs. This is a known development repository, not held-out confirmation or whole-product qualification.

trigger.interpretation: Both initial observations succeeded and emitted identical partial-graph artifacts. Candidate took longer; cause unproven. Preserve both observations outside the new repeated panel.

isolation: Start only after the registered Blob query capture and its verification terminate. No own compilation, other extraction, query capture or large-graph verification alongside these timed runs. Unrelated host work remains uncontrolled and must be disclosed. Keep ordinary OS caches; no warmups or cache flushing.
observations: Record every result, UTC timestamps, host load before/after, wall time, user/sys CPU time, peak RSS and raw process-resource output. Preserve every timeout, artifact error and omission warning. Hash whole graphs and verify equal bytes against the original preserved artifact; do not exclude metadata or array order.
decision: Report all six observations and per-binary medians only when all three observations of that binary succeed with admitted artifacts. Report a median ratio only if all six artifacts equal the original bytes. Flag a candidate median above 1.10 times baseline for investigation; do not approve a new performance baseline from this one repository. Do not explain differences as host noise or regex contention without further evidence.
noSubstitution: Do not replace original full-source observations, SQL-file timings, previous unoptimized timeouts, graph admission failures or Graphify results. No reduced-source fallback or selective repeat of slow outcomes.
broaderLimits: This performance diagnosis does not evaluate god-object classification, explanation quality, source precision, communities or overall superiority.
